blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) recently broke ground for Campus One building in the company's first destination estate, Bridgetowne.

The new campus is located in the Pasig City side of the development will be leased by FinAsia Land Development and Construction Corporation (FinAsia). The seat leasing company will occupy the three-story building with a total leasable space of 19,578 square meters (sqm).

Robinsons Land Corporation and FinAsia executives attended the groundbreaking ceremony to officially signal the start the construction of Campus One. The office building is expected to be completed within the 3rd quarter of 2020.

“We are delighted to contribute to the continued growth of Pasig City as a commercial district by building Campus One in Bridgetowne East. This will be the first of many exciting developments you can expect from our premier destination estate” said Jericho P. Go, General Manager for Office Buildings Division of RLC.

“FinAsia selected Campus One for its expansion into Pasig City because of Robinsons Land Corporation’s excellent track record of delivering quality office projects” said Manuel E. Pangilinan, President, CEO, and founder of FinAsia.

FinAsia is as seat leasing, office space fit-out, and facilities management company with an existing footprint of more than 31,000 square meters of office space around Metro Manila. Some of its major clients are business process outsourcing (BPO), and e-commerce companies.

Bridgetowne is a 30-hectare property that straddles between two cities in Metro Manila, Quezon and Pasig. It features a masterfully-planned destination estate, the site of several office buildings, a mall, residential buildings, and other soon-to-rise world-class projects. Its centerpiece is the bridge that crosses over Marikina River, a crossing that was inspired by the late National Artist for Architecture, Francisco Mañosa.

RLC is one of the top real estate developers in the country. It is also one of the leading office building developers and is the top choice for many companies across various industries when it comes to setting up a place of business. Having an impressive office property portfolio, especially in Ortigas Central Business District also in Pasig City, the real estate company brings its expertise to Bridgetowne.
The developer's completed office buildings in Bridgetowne include LEED accredited and PEZA certified projects such as: Tera Tower, Exxa Tower, Zeta Tower, and Giga Tower.

Campus One is newest office building development to rise in the Pasig side known as Bridgetowne East, and is also the first campus-style low-rise building in the vicinity. It will feature spacious office floor areas with more than 6,840 sqm of office space on the second and third floors and 4,890 sqm. on the ground floor. Prime spaces on the ground floor will be earmarked for retail in support of the tenants of the building.
The building will also be equipped with 100 percent emergency back-up power system for uninterrupted business operations. The campus will likewise use an energy-saving VRF air conditioning system.

Bridgetowne's location is one of the major draws for many companies to set-up businesses here. Just a few minutes away from Ortigas CBD, it has access to major thoroughfares including C-5, Ortigas Avenue Extension, and Amang Rodriguez Avenue.

The development is also carefully planned to suit the needs of residents and office workers. It will have a central park and several pocket parks, making the property greener than most townships. Several commercial spaces including a Robinsons mall will cater to not only the residents and workers in Bridgetowne but also the residents from the area. A five-star hotel will also rise in the property. And aside from the artfully designed bridge, a 60-meter art installation by Filipino-American artist Jefre Manuel, called The Victor, will soon become an icon of the destination estate
